Why do people get in their own way right before winning?

Kevin Trudeau says a hidden counter-intention can stop someone or make them sabotage themselves. It shows up as an irrational emotion or thought pattern when something pushes their buttons or they feel triggered.

He says different traditions give these blocks different names, but the pattern is the same. It works against goals and dreams, and unless it is cleared, a challenge is coming.

When did you last get in your own way?
